title: Static Open Ribcage and Two Leg Skeleton
description: One complete newly authored fictional standing biped skeleton on a dedicated low plinth. A vertically joint-swollen spine connects a short open pelvic ring, stacked paired three-dimensional rib arches and front sternum, narrow neck and hollow cranium. Two actual forward eye orbits and a smaller nose opening pierce the thick skull shell; a complete U-shaped lower jaw leaves a real mouth gap below the blunt upper tooth silhouettes. Two full arm chains terminate in simplified hands, while two full long leg chains end in broad finite forefeet on the low base. All poses, sections, skull shell and rib paths newly authored, not the existing quadruped skeleton rotated upright, a centaur trimmed, or old fish ribs multiplied. Three opaque PBR materials, metres Z-up and horizontal complete-envelope centred ground origin, one whole static fantasy figure zero scenes. Fictional non-gory art only: no real human anatomical fidelity, actual bone count, medical, scientific or educational accuracy, balance, gait, articulation, rig, animation, collision or safety claim. No weapon, blood, injury or separately counted bones.
